narrative.intro: Bae Systems Maritime Solutions Norfolk reported $519M in contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Bae Systems Maritime Solutions Norfolk received 10 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $51.9M. Bae Systems Maritime Solutions Norfolk obligations are up 75.5% year over year. Bae Systems Maritime Solutions Norfolk has a multi-year pattern of deal flow: FY21 obligations were $355M, FY22 obligations were $299M, FY23 obligations were $523M, FY24 obligations were $148M, FY25 obligations were $296M, and FY26 obligations are $519M. Bae Systems Maritime Solutions Norfolk current-year totals are fiscal year to date and are therefore partial. Bae Systems Maritime Solutions Norfolk reporting differentiates contract obligations from award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Bae Systems Maritime Solutions Norfolk data shows a rebound in FY26 compared with FY25 and FY24, and FY26 obligations are similar in scale to FY23 when measured by total obligations.
